schema.text: What do you use your motorcycle or scooter for? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Travelling at night or getting to night shifts, when public transport is scarce
Getting around because my area is poorly served by public transport
Being sure of getting back, even after many hours
Making unexpected trips, even out of town

it.#What do you use your motorcycle or scoo: Per cosa usi la moto o lo scooter? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Spostarmi di notte o raggiungere i turni di notte, quando i mezzi pubblici sono pochi
it.#Getting around because my area is poorl: Spostarmi perché la mia zona è poco servita dai mezzi pubblici
it.#Being sure of getting back, even after: Avere la certezza di tornare, anche dopo molte ore
it.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Fare spostamenti imprevisti, anche fuori città

fr.#What do you use your motorcycle or scoo: Pour quoi utilisez-vous votre moto ou votre scooter ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Me déplacer la nuit ou me rendre à un travail de nuit, quand les transports en commun sont rares
fr.#Getting around because my area is poorl: Me déplacer parce que mon quartier est mal desservi par les transports en commun
fr.#Being sure of getting back, even after: Avoir la certitude de pouvoir rentrer, même après de nombreuses heures
fr.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Faire des trajets imprévus, même hors de la ville

de.#What do you use your motorcycle or scoo: Wofür nutzen Sie Ihr Motorrad oder Ihren Roller? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Nachts unterwegs sein oder zur Nachtschicht kommen, wenn kaum öffentliche Verkehrsmittel fahren
de.#Getting around because my area is poorl: Unterwegs sein, weil meine Gegend schlecht mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erschlossen ist
de.#Being sure of getting back, even after: Sicher sein, wieder zurückzukommen, auch nach vielen Stunden
de.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Unvorhergesehene Fahrten machen, auch außerhalb der Stadt

tr.#What do you use your motorcycle or scoo: Motosikletinizi veya scooter'ınızı ne için kullanıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Toplu taşımanın az olduğu saatlerde geceleri yolculuk etmek veya gece vardiyalarına gitmek
tr.#Getting around because my area is poorl: Bölgeme toplu taşıma yeterince hizmet vermediği için ulaşmak
tr.#Being sure of getting back, even after: Saatler sonra bile geri dönebileceğimden emin olmak
tr.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Şehir dışı da dahil, beklenmedik yolculuklar yapmak

fa.#What do you use your motorcycle or scoo: از موتور یا اسکوتر خود برای چه کارهایی استفاده می‌کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Travelling at night or getting to night: سفر در شب یا رفتن به شیفت شب، وقتی حمل‌ونقل عمومی کم است
fa.#Getting around because my area is poorl: جابه‌جایی به‌دلیل ضعف خدمات حمل‌ونقل عمومی در محله من
fa.#Being sure of getting back, even after: اطمینان از بازگشت، حتی پس از ساعت‌های طولانی
fa.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: سفرهای پیش‌بینی‌نشده، حتی به خارج از شهر

hu.#What do you use your motorcycle or scoo: Mire használja a motorkerékpárját vagy robogóját? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Éjszakai utazás vagy éjszakai műszakba járás, amikor kevés a tömegközlekedés
hu.#Getting around because my area is poorl: Közlekedés, mert a környékem rosszul ellátott tömegközlekedéssel
hu.#Being sure of getting back, even after: Biztos hazajutás, akár sok óra elteltével is
hu.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Váratlan utak, akár a városon kívülre is

ar.#What do you use your motorcycle or scoo: ما الأغراض التي تستخدم دراجتك النارية أو السكوتر من أجلها؟ (يمكن اختيار كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#Travelling at night or getting to night: التنقل ليلًا أو الوصول إلى نوبات العمل الليلية، حين يقل النقل العام
ar.#Getting around because my area is poorl: التنقل لأن منطقتي تخدمها وسائل النقل العام بشكل سيئ
ar.#Being sure of getting back, even after: التأكد من العودة حتى بعد ساعات طويلة
ar.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: القيام برحلات غير متوقعة، حتى خارج المدينة
